name: slide-smith
description: Turns raw material into a reviewed outline, a page-by-page slide spec rendered as a runnable HTML deck, then a finished deck — as HTML or editable PPTX. Four gated steps, a stored preference library, 5 visual styles (all with clickable HTML samples) and 14 argument methods (both addressed by Chinese names), chosen independently.

displayDescription.en: Turns your material into an outline, a page-by-page slide deck and a finished presentation — HTML, editable PPTX or per-page generated-visual PPTX. Four gated reviews, 6 visual styles (with an HTML style picker: 6 clickable sample decks) and 14 argument methods (pick 3 from a card), chosen separately.
displayDescription.zh: 资料拆成大纲、逐页分镜与成片演示，HTML、PPTX、生图 PPTX 三选一，四步审核，风格可换。
